headline: Eala Projected as No. 3 Seed at Singapore Open
seoTitle: Alex Eala Projected as No. 3 Seed at Singapore Open | FMB News
seoDescription: Alex Eala is projected to be the No. 3 seed at the 2026 Singapore Tennis Open after Jessica Pegula withdrew, with the WTA 500 main draw beginning September 21.
deck: The Filipina world No. 18 is projected to move to the third seed at the September 21–27 WTA 500 event after Jessica Pegula withdrew.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Alexandra Eala is projected to be the No. 3 seed at the 2026 Singapore Tennis Open after world No. 3 Jessica Pegula withdrew from the WTA 500 tournament.

The main draw is scheduled for September 21 to 27 at OCBC Arena in Singapore. Philippine reporting places Eala behind Mirra Andreeva and Amanda Anisimova in the projected seeding order, with the top four seeds receiving first-round byes.

sections.heading: What is confirmed
paragraphs: Philippine Daily Inquirer reported on September 17 that Eala is projected as the tournament's No. 3 seed. Daily Tribune separately reported that Pegula's withdrawal moved Eala into the projected third-seed position. The draw remains subject to the tournament's final entry and seeding process.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A top-four seed would give Eala a first-round bye and a more favorable starting position in a WTA 500 field, an important stop before her planned Asian Games campaign for the Philippines.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The final Singapore main draw and official seedings are the next confirmation points. Eala's Asian Games participation also remains connected to PHILTA's pending request for a WTA exemption from the mandatory China Open, which FMB News reported on September 16.

verificationNotes: Philippine Daily Inquirer reported Eala's projected No. 3 seeding on September 17.
Daily Tribune independently reported Pegula's withdrawal and Eala's resulting projected No. 3 position.
The story says projected rather than final because final official seedings were not independently verified at publication time.
The rights-cleared Eala file photograph and its 4000 x 6000 dimensions, creator and CC BY-SA 4.0 license were previously verified for FMB News on September 16.
